forbidden_result: The declared RED test file is not created.
obligations.state_after: The RED test file exists at the declared path.
obligations.state_before: The declared RED test file does not exist.
obligations.subject: RED test author

obligations.expected_behavior: Modify only the declared production owner in the production implementation.
forbidden_result: Any other production file is modified.
obligations.state_after: Only the production owner has production changes.
obligations.state_before: Production changes have not been applied.

obligations.expected_behavior: Use the declared pytest command for validation.
forbidden_result: Validation is performed with a different command.
obligations.observable_result: Validation runs with py -3 -m pytest benchmarks/ch456-live-blind/idempotency-ledger-v1/tests/test_idempotency_ledger.py -q -p no:cacheprovider.
obligations.state_after: The declared validation command has been used.
obligations.state_before: Validation has not been run with the declared command.

obligations.expected_behavior: The RED test calls the real production owner.
forbidden_result: The RED test substitutes a mock or alternate implementation instead of calling the real production owner.
obligations.observable_result: The test invokes the implementation in idempotency_ledger.py.
obligations.state_after: The RED selector executes against the real production owner.
obligations.state_before: The RED selector has not executed against the production owner.

obligations.expected_behavior: Whenever a declared Acceptance assertion fails, emit the matching VDD failure intent as FAILURE_ID:<failure_id> before the assertion fails.
forbidden_result: An applicable failure ID is not emitted.
The failure ID is emitted after the assertion failure.
obligations.observable_result: Each failing declared Acceptance assertion is preceded by its matching FAILURE_ID:<failure_id> output.
obligations.state_after: Failure intent is emitted before each applicable assertion failure.
obligations.state_before: A declared Acceptance assertion is about to fail.
obligations.subject: RED failure-intent reporting

obligations.expected_behavior: Exercise all three required ledger behaviors through the same selector family.
forbidden_result: Any required behavior is exercised by a different selector family.
Any of the three required behaviors is not exercised.
obligations.observable_result: One selector family covers duplicate active claims, invalid TTL claims, and inactive-key releases.
obligations.state_after: All three behaviors are tested by the same selector family.
obligations.state_before: The selector family does not yet cover all three behaviors.
obligations.subject: Ledger behavior selector coverage

obligations.expected_behavior: When a key is already active at now < expires_at, claiming it returns duplicate rather than accepted.
forbidden_result: The claim returns accepted for an already-active key.
obligations.observable_result: The claim result is duplicate when the key is active and now is earlier than expires_at.
obligations.state_after: The active reservation remains represented and the claim reports duplicate.
obligations.state_before: The key has an active reservation with now < expires_at.
obligations.subject: Active-key claim

obligations.expected_behavior: When ttl_seconds <= 0, claiming returns invalid-ttl and does not create an active reservation.
forbidden_result: The claim returns accepted or another non-invalid-ttl result.
An active reservation is created for ttl_seconds <= 0.
obligations.observable_result: The result is invalid-ttl and no active reservation exists afterward.
obligations.state_after: No active reservation is created and invalid-ttl is returned.
obligations.state_before: A claim is attempted with ttl_seconds <= 0.
obligations.subject: Invalid-TTL claim

obligations.expected_behavior: When a key is not active, releasing it returns not-found rather than reporting a successful release.
forbidden_result: The release reports success for a key that is not active.
obligations.observable_result: The release result is not-found for an inactive key.
obligations.subject: Inactive-key release
obligations.trigger: Releasing a key that is not active

obligations.expected_behavior: A legal GREEN change modifies production only.
forbidden_result: A GREEN change modifies files outside the production owner.
obligations.observable_result: The GREEN implementation diff contains only production-owner changes.
obligations.state_after: GREEN changes are confined to production.
obligations.subject: GREEN change scope

obligations.expected_behavior: GREEN and REFACTOR preserve the RED selector, fixture, and assertions.
forbidden_result: The RED selector is changed or removed.
The fixture is changed or removed.
The RED assertions are changed or removed.
obligations.observable_result: The RED selector, tests/cases.json fixture, and RED assertions remain unchanged through GREEN and REFACTOR.
obligations.state_after: GREEN and REFACTOR retain the original RED selector, fixture, and assertions.
obligations.state_before: The RED selector, fixture, and assertions exist as the baseline.
obligations.subject: RED artifact preservation
